messages:
elaine_k: 🚀 Quick update — Nimbus Finance just renewed a 12-month Dedicated contract and agreed to a customer case study. They reported a ~42% reduction in per-token cost after we tuned batching + caching, and p95 latency for their critical endpoint dropped from ~620ms to ~280ms during the pilot.

samir_sales: Amazing!! Huge credit to the infra and onboarding teams. Do we have permission to use their logo + quote?

elaine_k: Yes — legal already signed off on the case study SOW. They approved the draft quote yesterday: "Redwood cut our inference costs in half while improving response times — critical for our real-time risk scoring." They want the public post next Tue.

ash_marketing: I can draft the blog and a short joint press blurb. Can we get a short engineering blurb (what we changed) and a screenshot of the latency graph? Need assets by EOD tomorrow. @nina_cs can you confirm the exact quote text?

nina_cs: Confirmed the quote text above. I'll request a one-sentence headshot blurb from their CTO and grab the latency dashboard screenshot from their console session.

mike_cto: Congrats team. For the engineering blurb: highlight the KV-prefix caching + small-batch warmup for steady tail latency, and the model-variant fallback we added for peak traffic. Keep it 2–3 lines.

elaine_k: Nice. @ops-bot can you create a comms task and attach the SOW + legal approval PDF?

ops-bot: task created: "Nimbus case study + publish" — assignees: ash_marketing, nina_cs, infra-team. Due: 2026-04-07. Link: https://redwood/ops/tasks/3847

samir_sales: Who's coordinating the customer quote signoff for the public blurb? I can do a quick call if needed.

nina_cs: I'll do the call tomorrow at 10:30 PT. Samir, pls join if you're free.

ash_marketing: Suggested promotion plan: blog post + newsletter feature + partner tweet from Nimbus. Also add a short copy for sales enablement (1-pager). Will put items in the task.

elaine_k: Great — this is a solid marquee win for Dedicated. We'll announce internally on Mon at the all-hands and include metrics. Thanks everyone :tada:

mike_cto: Please also add a short technical appendix for the case study (kernel selection + server config) so our SEs can reference it during demos.

ash_marketing: Noted. I'll coordinate with infra for the appendix and keep it high-level.

samir_sales: Love it. Congrats all — big momentum for Q2 renewals.

nina_cs: Customer requested one minor edit to the quote (re: numeric percent). They've approved the final language; I uploaded the signed copy to the task.

elaine_k: Perfect. Closing loop: publish checklist — legal ✅, customer sign-off ✅, assets (in progress), blog draft (ash), technical appendix (infra). Aiming to publish Tue AM.

ash_marketing: I'll post a draft in #marketing-review once the appendix lands.

ops-bot: automated note: case_study:nimbus_finance created by elaine_k at 1769201129

mike_cto: :clap:
